¿ (…) es: Rentista?........................... 1 Jubilado o pensionado?.... 2 Estudiante?....................... 3 Ama de casa?................... 4 Incapacitado?.................... 5 Otro, cuál? (Especifique)…… 6

assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument's filter/screener questions for work (Pregunta 20 and Pregunta 21) restrict economic activity/work to paid employment, business activities, or production for income or family enterprises. Unpaid domestic and care work within the person's own household is not classified or measured as economic activity; rather, performing unpaid household work is categorized as a state of inactivity ('Ama de casa' in Pregunta 36). Therefore, unpaid domestic and care work is treated as a separate category (inactivity) rather than incorporated into the definition of work.
